notes.vi:
### Fixed
- Side-panel chats are now reported to the AgentX SSO usage dashboard. Streamed ask-mode turns were never counted, so AgentX WebMate did not appear among the dashboard's products.

### Changed
- AgentX Skill Hub is now called AgentX AgentHub (AgentHub for short) in Settings and its messages. Installed skills and saved hub addresses carry over unchanged.
